member.name: T:DisCatSharp.GatewayAdvancedConfiguration
member.summary: Advanced configuration for Discord gateway transport tuning.
member.remarks: Properties in this class control low-level transport behavior and should rarely need adjustment.

member.name: M:DisCatSharp.GatewayAdvancedConfiguration.#ctor
member.summary: Creates a new gateway advanced configuration with default values.

member.name: M:DisCatSharp.GatewayAdvancedConfiguration.#ctor(DisCatSharp.GatewayAdvancedConfiguration)
member.summary: Creates a clone of another gateway advanced configuration.

summary.para: Controls how user event handlers are dispatched after ordered internal processing.
Internal cache and state mutations are always processed in FIFO order per shard, regardless of this setting. This only affects when and how user-facing event handlers are invoked.
Defaults to .
Sets the bounded capacity of the internal dispatch queue per shard.

When the queue is full, back-pressure will be applied to the WebSocket reader, which may cause the gateway to close the connection if heartbeat ACKs are delayed. Increase this value if your bot processes events slowly and receives high event volume.
Defaults to 10,000. Set to 0 for an unbounded queue.
Maximum time the socket lock will wait before auto-unlocking after an IDENTIFY payload is sent.
If the gateway does not respond to an IDENTIFY within this duration, the lock is released so that other shards can proceed. Increase this value on very slow connections.
Must be positive. Defaults to 30 seconds.
Delay before sending a RESUME after receiving an INVALID_SESSION with d: true.
Discord recommends waiting a few seconds before resuming a session to avoid rate-limit issues. Adjust this if you experience frequent resume failures or want faster reconnection.
Must be positive. Defaults to 6 seconds.
Number of consecutive missed heartbeat ACKs before the connection is declared a zombie.
When the threshold is exceeded after guild download has completed, the client will trigger a event and force a reconnect. During guild download the event fires as a warning only.
Defaults to 5.

member.name: T:DisCatSharp.GatewayConfiguration
member.summary: Configuration for Discord gateway connection settings.

member.name: M:DisCatSharp.GatewayConfiguration.#ctor
member.summary: Creates a new gateway configuration with default values.

member.name: M:DisCatSharp.GatewayConfiguration.#ctor(DisCatSharp.GatewayConfiguration)
member.summary: Creates a clone of another gateway configuration.

summary.para: Sets whether to automatically reconnect in case a connection is lost.
Defaults to .
Defines that the client should attempt to reconnect indefinitely.
This is typically a very bad idea to set to true, as it will swallow all connection errors.
Defaults to .
Sets the ID of the shard to connect to.
If not sharding, or sharding automatically, this value should be left with the default value of 0.

Must be non-negative and less than . The cross-constraint against is enforced at connection time — this setter only guards against negative values since the two properties may be assigned in any order during configuration.
Sets the total number of shards the bot is on. If not sharding, this value should be left with a default value of 1.
If sharding automatically, this value will indicate how many shards to boot. If left default for automatic sharding, the client will determine the shard count automatically.
Must be greater than 0. The cross-constraint that must be less than this value is enforced at connection time.
Sets the level of compression for WebSocket traffic.

Disabling this option will increase the amount of traffic sent via WebSocket. Setting will enable compression for READY and GUILD_CREATE payloads. Setting will enable compression for the entire WebSocket stream, drastically reducing amount of traffic.
Defaults to .
Sets the member count threshold at which guilds are considered large.
Discord only accepts values between 50 and 250 (inclusive). Values outside this range are silently clamped to the nearest boundary.
Defaults to 250.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.GatewayConfiguration.Capabilities
member.summary: Gets or sets the gateway capabilities for this connection.

summary.para: Sets if the bot's status should show the mobile icon.
Defaults to .
Sets the factory method used to create instances of WebSocket clients.
Use and equivalents on other implementations to switch out client implementations.
Defaults to .
Sets the factory method used to create instances of UDP clients.
Use and equivalents on other implementations to switch out client implementations.
Defaults to .
Advanced transport tuning options.
Most applications should not need to modify these settings.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.QueueTimeout
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum time a request may wait in a bucket queue before being failed with a .

remarks.para: Set to to disable the timeout entirely (wait forever).
Must be non-negative. The default is 5 minutes.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.QueueWarningThreshold
member.summary: Gets or sets the duration after which a warning log is emitted for a queued request that has not yet started.

remarks.para: Set to to disable the warning.
Must be non-negative. Defaults to 2 minutes.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.MaxRetries
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum number of automatic retries for a request that receives a retryable response. Applies to rate-limit responses (429) and transient server errors (500, 502, 503, 504). Server errors use exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, …); rate limits use the server-provided Retry-After.
member.remarks: Must be non-negative. Defaults to 5. Set to 0 to disable retries entirely.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.MaxQueueDepthPerBucket
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum number of requests that can be queued per bucket. When the limit is reached, new requests are immediately failed with .

remarks.para: Must be non-negative. Set to 0 to disable the limit (unbounded queue). Defaults to 1000.
This protects against OOM from runaway request patterns on a single endpoint.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.RetryTransientErrors
member.summary: Gets or sets whether transient HTTP errors (DNS failures, socket errors, connection timeouts) should be retried with exponential backoff, up to .

remarks.para: Defaults to . Set to to fail immediately on network errors.
Only transient errors are retried — permanent errors (e.g. 404, 403) always fail immediately.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.CircuitBreakerThreshold
member.summary: Gets or sets the number of consecutive failures on a single bucket before the circuit breaker opens. When open, new requests to that bucket are immediately failed without sending HTTP requests.

remarks.para: Must be non-negative. Set to 0 to disable the circuit breaker. Defaults to 10.
The circuit breaker resets after with no new failures.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.CircuitBreakerResetTimeout
member.summary: Gets or sets the duration after which a tripped circuit breaker transitions to half-open, allowing a single probe request through.
member.remarks: Must be positive. Defaults to 30 seconds.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.PreemptiveRatelimitBuffer
member.summary: Gets or sets the safety buffer added to preemptive rate-limit timing. This margin extends the preemptive wait slightly past the server-advertised reset boundary, absorbing clock drift and network jitter to prevent real 429 responses at bucket edges.

remarks.para: Must be non-negative and at most 5 seconds. Defaults to 250 milliseconds.
Set to to disable the buffer (trust server timing exactly).
The buffer is applied to preemptive delay computation, bucket window reopening, and post-429 retry delays.

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.RestAdvancedConfiguration.FailFastMode
member.summary: Enables fail-fast mode: disables all retries and circuit breaker cooldown, and sets a short queue timeout. When enabled, any REST failure is surfaced immediately without automatic recovery attempts.

remarks.para: This overrides , , , and when set to .
Intended for library developer diagnostics. Not part of the public API surface.

member.summary: Whether to enable bad domain checker support.

member.name: M:DisCatSharp.Entities.DiscordAuditLogEntry.HydrateAsync(DisCatSharp.Enums.AuditLogHydrationTargets,System.Boolean,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Replaces audit log placeholder references with cached or freshly fetched live entities.
member.param: Controls which reference groups should be hydrated.
Controls whether the helper may perform REST requests when the requested entities are not already cached.
A token to cancel the request.
member.returns: A task representing the asynchronous hydration operation.

remarks.para: Audit log parsing intentionally avoids implicit REST calls and may therefore expose partial synthetic entities. Calling this method allows consumers to opt into upgrading those references after parsing.

When is , only cached entities are used and no network request is issued. When it is , the helper fetches live entities for resolvable references where DisCatSharp exposes an appropriate retrieval API.
Missing or deleted targets are treated as a best-effort miss and leave the existing partial reference in place. Other API failures still bubble to the caller.

member.exception: Thrown when Discord denies one of the requested live fetches.
Thrown when Discord rejects one of the requested live fetches.
Thrown when Discord is unable to process one of the requested live fetches.

member.summary: Represents a query for fetching guild audit log entries.

member.remarks: Supplying a before cursor keeps Discord's default descending order. This cursor cannot be combined with .

member.name: P:DisCatSharp.Entities.DiscordAuditLogQuery.After

member.name: T:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayDispatchMode
member.summary: Specifies how user event handlers are dispatched after ordered internal processing.
member.remarks: Regardless of the selected mode, internal cache and state mutations are always processed in FIFO order per shard. This setting only controls how user-facing event handlers (Client.MessageCreated += …) are invoked after the internal processing completes.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayDispatchMode.ConcurrentHandlers
member.summary:
After internal processing completes for a dispatch event, user event handlers are fired concurrently (fire-and-forget). Multiple events may have their user handlers running at the same time.
This is the default mode and provides the best throughput for most bots.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayDispatchMode.SequentialHandlers
member.summary:
After internal processing completes for a dispatch event, user event handlers are awaited before the next dispatch event is processed. This fully serializes both internal processing and user handler execution.
Use this mode when your handlers depend on strict event ordering and cannot tolerate overlap.

member.summary: Enables versioned user guild settings; user_guild_settings becomes an object and can be cached when re-identifying.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.summary: Splits the Ready payload into Ready and Ready Supplemental for faster initial receipt.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.summary: Changes guild_experiments populations to an array of populations in the Ready event.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayCapabilities.NON_CHANNEL_READ_STATES
member.summary: Includes read states tied to non-channel resources (e.g., scheduled events, notification center).
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayCapabilities.AUTH_TOKEN_REFRESH
member.summary: Enables auth token refresh, optionally providing a new auth token in the Ready event.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayCapabilities.USER_SETTINGS_PROTO
member.summary: Removes user_settings from Ready and User Settings Update events; uses user_settings_proto instead.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayCapabilities.CLIENT_STATE_V2
member.summary: Enables client state caching v2.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayCapabilities.PASSIVE_GUILD_UPDATE
member.summary: Enables passive guild updates, replacing certain events with Passive Update V1 for unsubscribed guilds.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayCapabilities.AUTO_CALL_CONNECT
member.summary: Connects to all pre-existing calls upon connecting to the Gateway.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayCapabilities.DEBOUNCE_MESSAGE_REACTIONS
member.summary: Debounces message reactions, emitting Message Reaction Add Many instead of rapid single adds.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.GatewayCapabilities.PASSIVE_GUILD_UPDATE_V2
member.summary: Enables passive guild updates v2, sending Passive Update V2 for unsubscribed guilds.
member.remarks: Not for bot accounts.

member.name: T:DisCatSharp.Enums.AuditLogHydrationTargets
member.summary: Controls which audit log references should be upgraded by .
member.remarks: Audit log parsing is intentionally side-effect free and may therefore produce partial or synthetic entities. These flags allow callers to selectively replace those placeholders with cached or freshly fetched live data.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.AuditLogHydrationTargets.None
member.summary: Does not hydrate any references.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.AuditLogHydrationTargets.Actor
member.summary: Hydrates the acting moderator or actor reference.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.AuditLogHydrationTargets.Target
member.summary: Hydrates the primary target reference for the entry family.
member.remarks: Examples include the target member, role, webhook, scheduled event, thread, or soundboard sound.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.AuditLogHydrationTargets.Related
member.summary: Hydrates secondary or contextual references attached to the entry family.
member.remarks: Examples include channels referenced through the options payload, overwrite principals, or related members on message and auto moderation entries.

member.name: F:DisCatSharp.Enums.AuditLogHydrationTargets.All
member.summary: Hydrates the actor, primary target, and related references.

member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
